text: Hi, yeah, this is Frank Moore. I smell gas in my basement, and I need someone to come out tomorrow morning to check it.
Please leave the building right now and don't touch any light switches or appliances. Once you're outside, call 911 or your gas utility's emergency line.

For your safety, I cannot book a visit for a gas smell. Please step outside immediately and call 911 or your gas utility. Are you safe outside now?
Alright, fine, I'm outside now. But I still need someone booked for tomorrow.
May I please have your address and a callback phone number so I can log this safety report?
